title: tc-breakdown-chart
description: A stacked bar chart with a linked table: pick the measure, the slice and the segment; legend chips hide segments.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

fill.description: Grow to the container's width instead of stopping at 560px

records.description: The rows to chart – one object per item, with a value for each dimension key and each measure field

dimensions.description: The fields people can slice and segment by, with their values in display order

measures.description: What the bars can measure – a count of records, or the sum of a field

measure.description: Measure key; unset is the first measure

slice.description: Dimension key the bars are sliced by; unset is the first dimension

segment.description: Dimension key the bars are segmented by, or "none" for single-color bars; unset is the second dimension

hiddenSegments.description: Segment values hidden from the bars and totals; picking another segment clears it (`hidden` is the HTML attribute)

colors.description: Colors per value, used when this dimension segments the bars – keep each at 3:1 or more against the surface in both themes

icons.description: Small icon element per value (cloned), shown under the bars and in the table

unit.description: Unit after the total, e.g. "tasks" or "points"

field.description: Field to sum – leave empty to count records
